assets.label: Natural Earth land fallback
assets.notes: Modern macro-geography fallback only. It is not an ancient coastline reconstruction.

assets.label: Copernicus GLO-30 terrain PMTiles
assets.notes: Modern DSM relief only. Ancient terrain changes and archaeological reconstruction remain separate overlays. Prefer R2/S3/CDN hosting; do not commit a large regional PMTiles archive to GitHub Pages.

assets.label: DARE Roman roads
assets.notes: Contextual Roman road network. Individual line geometry must not be presented as a recovered roadbed unless the underlying record supports that precision.

assets.label: Eastern Delta paleolake reconstruction
citations: Drews, C. & Han, W. (2010), PLOS ONE 5(8): e12481, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0012481
assets.notes: Must be independently authored from cited paleogeographic evidence and labeled approximate/reconstructed. Never encode an Exodus crossing point.

assets.label: Sea of Galilee first-century shoreline reconstruction
citations: User-supplied verification packet, Galilee Evidence Register
assets.notes: The packet supplies the -209 m research claim, but no production shoreline geometry. Do not generate a precise contour until the source bathymetry/elevation basis is available.

assets.label: Roman-period Ephesus paleocoastline
citations: Kraft, J. C., Brückner, H., Kayan, I. & Engelmann, H. (2007). Geoarchaeology 22(1), 121-149
assets.notes: Exact decade-specific shoreline geometry is interpolated; any future polygon must carry period and uncertainty metadata.

assets.label: Reconstructed ancient Jerusalem terrain surface
assets.notes: Must remain visibly distinct from modern DEM. Temple Mount subsurface and exact period-specific valley profiles remain unresolved.

assets.label: Megiddo archaeological spatial dataset
assets.notes: A specific Open Context dataset DOI and license must be selected before ingestion. Repository-level policy is not sufficient.

assets.label: Neo-Babylonian Babylon spatial layout
assets.notes: The packet describes Pedersen/Uppsala GIS, but alpha.9 does not contain a separately verified resource/license record for the specific downloadable files. Do not ingest until that is resolved.

assets.label: Historic landscape image pack
assets.notes: Every image must have an individual item URL and license record. Do not reuse the packet's mixed Trumpeting Stone image entry without re-verification.
